title: The Lost Library Key
synopsis: But the Reading Room is locked.
The big brass key is gone!
goal: Find out who has the key.

options.label: On the front desk
options.feedback: Read the note again. Is the desk by the window?

options.label: On the blue shelf by the window
In the Reading Room door
options.feedback: The door is locked. The key is not in it.

notes: Letter: Ms. Rosa's note. "I put the key on the blue shelf by the window. It was 9:00."
Question: Where did Ms. Rosa put the key?

learning.objective: 쪽지의 "on the blue shelf by the window"를 읽고 열쇠를 둔 곳을 고른다.
expressions: I put the key on the blue shelf by the window.

notes: Letter: the visitor book. Tom came at 9:10. He read by the door. Mr. Bell came at 9:20. He had a ladder. Mrs. Lee came at 9:40. She sat at the desk.
Question: Put the visitors in order. Who came first?

clueInputs.note: The key was put on the shelf at 9:00: everyone in the book came after it.

learning.objective: 방문 기록의 시각(9:10, 9:20, 9:40)을 읽고 온 순서대로 놓는다.

notes: Letter: a job card under the blue shelf. "Mr. Bell: please fix the P-M-A-L in the Reading Room before ten." The letters are mixed up.
Question: What must Mr. Bell fix? Put the letters in the right order.

clueInputs.note: Mr. Bell came with a ladder: the card says why.

learning.objective: 섞인 글자 P-M-A-L을 바로 놓아 lamp라는 단어를 쓴다.

notes: Question: The key was on the shelf at 9:00. Who came with a ladder, and had a job in the Reading Room? Spell the name to open the lock.
No lock box art (lockBoxes is optional): the plain LetterLockQuestion.

clueInputs.note: The key was on the shelf from 9:00.
Mr. Bell came at 9:20 with a ladder.
His job was the lamp in the Reading Room: he needed the key.

learning.objective: 세 단서(9:00 열쇠, 9:20 사다리, 램프 수리)를 이어 열쇠를 가져간 사람을 찾고 이름을 쓴다.
expressions: Who had a job in the Reading Room?

hook: The lamp is on. Story hour can start!

learningGoal.title: Where and when: by, on, at

notes: STEP 3-6 trial case. Written for this sandbox only: no London or Paris text, place or picture.
Every puzzle is a ready text-only palette puzzle: no new picture or sound.
Places (front_desk, window_shelf, reading_room) are plan ids only: no ScenePlace is registered for them.
